authority_note: Derived projection only. The Signed Task is the only Execution Authority and the Signed Evidence is the only proof. This document never authorizes an operation, and it adds no execution capability.

deploy_status.reason: the DEPLOY capability is present and installed, but request enablement is fail-closed and every release gate is HOLD. Capability presence is not deployment authorization, and no approved deployment plan is readable from the control bus

failed_or_invalid_tasks.reason: this Task predates the current Control Plane parameter contract; it is preserved for lineage but cannot be evaluated or counted as proof

final_release.reason: release acceptance is a separate axis from the business runtime and the Control Plane

health.reason: the newest VERIFY Evidence reports VERIFY_OK. This is the last proven moment, not present-moment liveness

hk_agent_last_activity.reason: the newest signed CONTROL_PLANE_HEALTH Evidence, at any age. Activity is not liveness

hk_agent_liveness.reason: the newest signed liveness Evidence is 690395 s old, outside the 1800 s window: a past success is not proof of current liveness

hk_deploy.reason: deployment authorization is not derived from the existence of a DEPLOY capability

hk_runtime_identity.reason: the canonical runtime host and the host that signed liveness Evidence are the same instance

last_evidence.reason: the newest signed Evidence on the control bus

last_failure.reason: the most recent terminal non-success is an expiry, not a proven failure: the task reached its expiry with no Evidence, and the agent ledger that would distinguish 'never picked up' from 'failed unpublished' is not on the control bus

last_request.reason: the newest Request file observed on a control-bus ref

last_task.reason: the newest signed task of this class observed on the control bus

live_verified_runtime.reason: the newest VERIFY Evidence names the image that was current at that moment. This is a point-in-time proof, not a continuous statement

production.reason: Production has not been touched and is out of scope for the Control Plane

repository_main_sha.reason: the repository main revision supplied to this run

repository_runtime_pointer.reason: the repository declares this runtime. A declaration is never the truth about what is running on Hong Kong, so this can never be PROVEN

rollback_source.reason: rollback eligibility is a candidate set derived from successful DEPLOY Evidence. It is not an approval and not a signed ROLLBACK task

runtime_built_from_main_sha.reason: the repository records the product source commit that this runtime was built from

runtime_canonical_main_sha.reason: the repository records the main commit at which the canonical runtime definition was frozen

runtime_verification.reason: the newest VERIFY Evidence is 116193 s old, outside the 86400 s window, so the live runtime is not recently verified. The declared and proven images differ

stuck_answer.reason: no published task is overdue. 13 recently expired and 8 historical expired task(s) are indexed separately and do not affect current health

test_pr_status.reason: the newest successful TEST_PR Evidence. An isolated offline build is not a deployment

verify_status.reason: the newest signed task of this class observed on the control bus
